statements.statement: The patient presents with intermittent palpitations
The patient has a history of atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery (I25.10)
CPT code 93229 (Mobile cardiac telemetry) was billed
Mobile cardiac telemetry is medically necessary to correlate symptomatic palpitations with underlying arrhythmias
Mobile cardiac telemetry is medically necessary to assess for ischemic changes
The denial was based on lack of required precertification or prior authorization
The diagnostic monitoring directly addresses the patient's symptomatic episodes in the context of their known coronary artery disease
